name: Adino
bio: Adino the Eznite, the Tachmonite, was chief among David's captains and foremost of "the Three," his most elite warriors — he once raised his spear against eight hundred men and killed them all in a single encounter (2 Samuel 23:8). The parallel roster in 1 Chronicles names this same chief captain Jashobeam the Hachmonite, crediting him with three hundred slain rather than eight hundred — a variation between the two accounts (1 Chronicles 11:11).
